purpose: Challenge how an interpreter act discovers and uses its role vocabulary without a host enum and without the circular requirement to know the role dictionary before locating the role-dictionary field itself.

candidateA.name: host-known-role-names
candidateA.problem: the replay schema still supplies the semantic list of role names externally

candidateB.name: theory-defined-role-forms
candidateB.shape: D_roles resolves role source to roleRef; T_roles admits a declarative form for roleRef

candidateC.name: role-dictionary-as-role-field
candidateC.reason: roleVocabulary cannot be resolved before D_roles is known, but D_roles is located only through roleVocabulary

candidateD.name: minimal-structural-act-header-plus-scoped-role-dictionary
bootstrapCore: A is start-self-closed and its end is H

requiredAssertions: candidate C is circular when the only way to locate D_roles is a field whose role itself requires D_roles
candidate D discovers I, D_roles and K' from A through a finite fixed structural header before any role-name lookup
candidate D fields are addressed using role refs resolved from exact string-Anum sources under the discovered D_roles
unknown role source rejects field lookup
conflicted role source rejects field lookup
same role source may resolve to different role refs under D1/D2
forged role dictionary in the act header changes/rejects field interpretation
forged role ref does not satisfy lookup for the expected role source
adding an optional new role field leaves all existing field resolutions unchanged
role dictionary can itself be ordinary payload outside the act header
two acts may use different role dictionaries while retaining the same low-level act/header topology
role refs and role dictionaries contain only ordinary binary links
no host enum/tag field is embedded in Link or act fields
candidate B can validate a resolved role after D_roles discovery but does not solve the bootstrap circularity by itself
notDecided: whether candidate D is the canonical interpreter-act header
whether every role requires a theory-admitted structural definition beyond dictionary naming
whether the minimal act header can later become fully self-describing without an infinite regress
versioning of the bootstrap act schema
